name: code-review-benchmark
description: Scoped Kiro agent for the code-review benchmark. Loads no MCP servers: the global mcp.json handshake (notably codebase-memory-mcp) grows kiro-cli to ~29GB RSS, and earlyoom then SIGTERMs the non-interactive run mid-review, before the required SARIF artifact is written. The participant skills only need built-in read/grep/glob/shell/write tools.
